# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest published version of each `ng-hub-ui-*` package receives security fixes.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report suspected vulnerabilities **privately** by email to
**carlos.morcillo@me.com** — do not open a public issue.

Include, when possible:

- The affected package and version (e.g. `ng-hub-ui-modal@22.x`).
- A description of the issue and its impact.
- Steps or a minimal snippet to reproduce it.

You will receive an acknowledgement as soon as possible, and a fix or mitigation
will be published with priority once the report is confirmed.
